title: Missing pointer guard
description: An embedded C change that dereferences an input pointer without validation.

findings.message: This dereferences ptr without a null guard and can fault when ptr is null.

title: Removed zero divisor protection
description: A code change in sensor scaling.

findings.message: The zero-divisor check was removed, so divisor equal to zero triggers undefined behavior.

title: Out of bounds buffer clearing
description: A change to a local buffer clearing loop.

findings.message: The loop writes buffer[capacity] on its last iteration, outside the provided capacity.

title: Equivalent branch for positive input
description: Equivalent behavior: x=0 returns zero via the final return.

title: Use unbounded copy into a fixed local buffer
description: A fixed-size local name buffer is now filled from an unconstrained source string.

findings.message: strcpy writes the complete source string without a bound and can exceed the eight-byte name buffer.

title: Fix DivideByZero exception when filesystem is completely full
description: Upstream littlefs pull request #966 changes the divisor used by the no-free-space diagnostic after block-count inference. The change is reviewed as a clean fix.

provenance.labelRationale: The diagnostic now uses the mounted filesystem's resolved block_count; the upstream PR also tests full-volume exhaustion with inferred block count.
